rationale: Both documents credit white-bear steering (WBS) by name as the prior stance-based method the new attentional-focus method departs from, and both give essentially the same novelty claim: the negative condition names no concept, isolating an engaged-attention state rather than a suppression stance, with a different effective layer band and dose.
